record.question: An individual or an organization selected under the Mizoram Bana Kaih (Handholding Scheme, 2024) is called
record.explanation: Answer A: Progress Partner. The scheme calls selected beneficiaries “Progress Partners.” Reference: https://dipr.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2024/09/60376305338d47b51ce799ca5bd9f299/notification-for-the-mizoram-bana-kaih-handholding-scheme-for-gazette-final-edit.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
